name: 立式紫外线杀菌灯款
description: 立柱灯管配金属护网，青光点亮全屋净化场景，一套讲透

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF packshots, cool mist-white #F1F6F5 info screens, one deep panel #1F7F79 for the closing screen, real home interiors with wood floors #D8C3A5 for scene shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused studio lighting, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, the lit tube used as a cool practical light, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless #FFFFFF studio sweep, matte mist-white board #F1F6F5, wood-grain floor #D8C3A5 and a soft ivory rug #EFEAE2
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif type for headline and label typesetting, short labels, no dense body text
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line outline icons at a consistent 2px stroke in #2FBFB2, rounded pill labels
styleLock.presentationRules: the product always standing upright on its round base, full column visible, stable scale and centered placement, the lit tube as the single luminous element
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean home-disinfection tech visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, cool mist-white #F1F6F5, charcoal text #2E3438, one luminous accent #2FBFB2 and one deep panel #1F7F79 reserved for the closing screen; cool tone; soft diffused studio lighting with a front-left key, fill and soft contact shadows plus the lit tube as a practical light; modern geometric sans-serif type for headline and label typesetting; consistent rounded pill labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; the product always standing upright at a stable scale and centered placement, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no turned-off tube.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，白底合规、无文字无道具
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, full upright column centered, base fully visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key with fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The tall upright product standing on its round base, straight-on eye-level view, full product visible with the tube lit, filling 60-70% of the frame so the composition reads complete. Bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill and a soft contact shadow grounding the base. Seamless background #FFFFFF. Commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no cut-off edges, no floating product.

provenance.notes: 从 9 屏爆款杀菌灯详情长图提炼；已剥离原品牌字、店铺角标、机型代号、原文案与全部原文数值（杀菌率/功率/波长/尺寸/电压等），杀菌率、波长、功率、认证一律改为 {callout_n} 文案槽位由使用方填写真实内容，不发明任何认证与数据；产品一律以 {product} 占位，配色与规格取自参考图。
